title: The Wellgorithm
tagline: Own, Customize, Share, Save or Mint Your Social Media Algorithm

prizes.placement: 🤝 Lens Protocol —  "follow on lens" or "sign in with lens"
prizes.title: Lens Protocol

description: The algorithms on social media are a beast of their own and it's become increasingly frustrating for users to consume content they no longer find useful, entertaining, or relevant. With 'The Wellgorithm' users will finally be able to take control and ownership over their algorithm. This project showcases how a potential social media application (build on Lens) would plug-in our wellgorithm protocol so that users could customize, save, share and reset their algorithm (with the potential to mint their algorithm as an NFT).
how_its_made: This project showcases how a potential social media application would use our algorithm protocol as a plug-in to enable users to customize the content they consume. We have also implemented Wallet Connect for users to sign in to their social media, Privy to store our data models(each individual social media model), & User interactions and events on any lens publications will be captured through our custom-built analytics tooling and stored in IPFS.
